sources.headline: Raiders rule Brock Bowers out with an ankle injury

sources.description: Las Vegas Raiders star tight end Brock Bowers exited Sunday afternoon's game against the Seattle Seahawks early in the first quarter with a right ankle injury.

sources.headline: No word on severity of Brock Bowers's ankle injury, will be re-evaluated Monday

sources.headline: Raiders TE Bowers avoided major ankle injury, source says
